description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'IdeaSourceProvider' with nested classes for handling source provider data in Android projects within IntelliJ IDEA, including methods for retrieving source directories, manifest files, and overlaying source sets, especially for Gradle and legacy projects.

classes.name: IdeaSourceProvider
classes.description: Abstract class representing source providers in Android projects within IntelliJ IDEA, with nested classes for Gradle and legacy project handling.

classes.name: Gradle
classes.description: Nested class for source provider handling in Gradle-based Android projects, converting File collections to VirtualFile sets.

classes.name: Legacy
classes.description: Nested class for source provider handling in legacy (non-Gradle) Android projects, retrieving source directories from project properties.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory methods to create IdeaSourceProvider instances from SourceProvider or AndroidFacet.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the source provider.

methods.name: getManifestFile
methods.description: Returns the VirtualFile for the manifest file, if available.

methods.name: getJavaDirectories
methods.description: Returns the set of VirtualFile representing Java source directories.

methods.name: getResourcesDirectories
methods.description: Returns the set of VirtualFile representing resource directories.

methods.name: getAidlDirectories
methods.description: Returns the set of VirtualFile representing AIDL directories.

methods.name: getRenderscriptDirectories
methods.description: Returns the set of VirtualFile representing RenderScript directories.

methods.name: getJniDirectories
methods.description: Returns the set of VirtualFile representing JNI directories.

methods.name: getJniLibsDirectories
methods.description: Returns the set of VirtualFile representing JNI Libs directories.

methods.name: getResDirectories
methods.description: Returns the set of VirtualFile representing resource directories.

methods.name: getAssetsDirectories
methods.description: Returns the set of VirtualFile representing assets directories.

methods.name: getCurrentSourceProviders
methods.description: Returns the list of source providers for the current variant, ordered for overlay purposes.

methods.name: getCurrentTestSourceProviders
methods.description: Returns the list of test source providers for the current variant.

methods.name: getAllSourceProviders
methods.description: Returns all source providers for a given AndroidFacet, including flavors, build types, and variants.

methods.name: getAllIdeaSourceProviders
methods.description: Returns IDEA-specific source providers for a given AndroidFacet.

methods.name: getIdeaSourceProvidersForFile
methods.description: Returns IDEA source providers that contain or are contained by a given VirtualFile.

methods.name: getSourceProvidersForFile
methods.description: Returns source providers that contain or are contained by a given VirtualFile.

methods.name: isManifestFile
methods.description: Checks if a given VirtualFile is the manifest file for the module.

methods.name: getManifestFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of all manifest files in the module.
